Definition: a testing, of men (judicial) or of God (querulous)
BiblicalUsage: The word names a testing, a trial, and Moses uses it for the wonders God worked to take a nation from the midst of another nation. By temptations, by signs and wonders, by war and a mighty hand, God brought Israel out of Egypt, and the psalm warns us not to harden our hearts as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness. Job says if the scourge slays suddenly, God will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe testing is how God shows a people who He is, because Egypt's plagues were His signs, not accidents. I hold that the same God who tested Israel in the wilderness tests us now, and the hardening of the heart is the one answer He will not accept.
